dct_description_sm:
Comprehensive polygon feature layer containing boundaries for parks, natural areas, facilities and all other properties that the Parks Department performs operational and maintenance work on in the City of Barrie. Relevant fields include park class, park type and park name.

The City of Barrie is situated in the heart of Central Ontario, a premier waterfront community on Lake Simcoe, conveniently located an hour north of Toronto.  Visit barrie.ca for more information or contact Service Barrie at 705-726-4242 or ServiceBarrie@barrie.ca
